note: Healthcare prints the customer's business facts directly in the Instructions (DECISIONS 88, option B). These are the only variables a healthcare Instructions set may use. Any other {{var.*}} is an error; so is an unresolved slot such as <business name>. This list replaces docs/shared/variables.json for healthcare.

variables.name: now_local
variables.description: Today's date and time for the call, with the dates of the coming days. Every date the agent says is read off this list.

variables.name: roster
variables.description: The doctor list from the Doctors setup: name, status (Available, On call, On leave), specialty, fees, about text and shifts. About 23 words per doctor in the Main prompt word count. Doctor details are never printed in the Instructions.

variables.name: patient_name
variables.description: Outbound calls: the name of the patient being called. Used only after the person is confirmed as the patient. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.

variables.name: appointment_details
variables.description: Outbound reminder calls: doctor, day and time of the appointment. Said only after the person is confirmed as the patient. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.
